items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: Tyce is a guy that - you can't believe this until you hear him; he can't play anything but what Louie Armstrong has already played.

ctx.x: Then there's a wonderful band there that I've made lots of tapes with and I recorded lots

of tapes with them; and, I did a couple of television shows. They call themselves "Swing Four Seven" and they've got the most fantastic rhythm section I ever heard. They have a dentist - my dentist by the way - who plays tenor saxophone, clarinet and alto and writes for this band and I want to tell you - you'd swear you're on 52nd Street. They've got that marvelous swing - that old swing era thing that they were doing in those days and he does a job on it. And, then, there's another band there that's very…
My God, you mean he just patterns everything he does---
